context: A Kansai chef and a barista discuss collabs
purpose: Teach: 餃子/バッハ/フォーク/試写/制服/中旬/体操/カ所

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: アオイさん、餃子フェアやらん?
lines.en: Aoi, are we gonna run a gyoza fair?
lines.style: Bright, easy energy. Kansai lilt rising on the question mark. Leaning in like this is already fun to imagine. No pressure — just genuine curiosity about her idea.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい!BGMにバッハを流して、上品な雰囲気にしたいです。
lines.en: Yes! I want to put Bach on in the background, make the whole thing feel really refined.
lines.style: Soft conviction without urgency. Eyes brightening as she pictures it. Thoughtful pace. The kind of quiet confidence that comes from already seeing it clearly.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: フォーク用カトラリーも、新調するで。
lines.en: We'll get fresh flatware too, yeah?
lines.style: Decisive Kansai drawl. Matter-of-fact, like he's checking boxes on a list but not rushing. Warm — supporting her vision without making it sound like work.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 試写会形式で、新メニュー先行公開も検討してます。
lines.en: I'm also thinking about doing a screening-style preview — giving people first access to the new menu items.
lines.style: Building momentum gently. Slightly faster than before, ideas flowing. Hopeful undertone — checking if this feels right to him. Voice lilts up slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 制服も、今月中旬には新調するで。
lines.en: New uniforms too — we'll have 'em sorted by mid-month.
lines.style: Grounded Kansai certainty. He's not asking; he's stating it like it's already decided. Warm authority — making sure she knows he's handling the details so she can focus on the big picture.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 体操教室を併設しているカフェも、一カ所でいいですから紹介してください。
lines.en: If you know any other cafes with gym classes attached, just one recommendation would help so much.
lines.style: Genuine, reaching-out tone. Soft but clear. Pace slows slightly — she's asking for something real, not just chatting. Warm closing, like she trusts he'll understand why this matters.
